note: NAME: driver's full name and surname repeated in narrative. State is incident scope only, not an address; MAC address and VIN are not supported types.
NAME: First Name field. PASSWORD: Password field under Login Information. Cookie timezone is not an address.
PASSWORD: explicit system password in last paragraph. Company name, coordinates, card number and URL are not supported types/addresses.
PASSWORD: value labelled 'the password' in Payment Terms. Provider is a company; customer ID is not a username.
USERNAME: admin user name; IP_ADDRESS: IPv4 tied to it; PASSWORD: password for that user.
US_SOCIAL_SECURITY_NUMBER: 9-digit value labelled social security number (repeated); PHONE: office phone; EMAIL: office email. No standalone person name outside the email.
PHONE: emergency number and fax number; EMAIL: contact email. Town/country is travel scope, not an address; coordinates, national id, beneficiary and biometric ids are not supported types.
PHONE: team phone number in Contact Us. Company name and URL are not supported types.
PHONE and EMAIL: contact details. City is vacation destination (scope), not an address; no standalone person name outside the email.
IP_ADDRESS: IPv4 and IPv6 columns; USERNAME: User Name column. JWT in cookie is a token, not a password.
USERNAME: user handle referenced as a user of the guide. URL is not a supported type.
USERNAME: User Name row; EMAIL: Email row; PHONE: Phone Number row. Name-like string appears only as username/email, not as a NAME.
NAME: designer's full name repeated; USERNAME: stated username; EMAIL: contact email. Beneficiary number not a supported type.
NAME: First/Last Name fields; US_SOCIAL_SECURITY_NUMBER: SSN field; ADDRESS: street, city, state, postcode fields. Card number not a supported type.
NAME: claimant name; US_SOCIAL_SECURITY_NUMBER: labelled social security number; ADDRESS: claimant's street residence.
PHONE: fax number in Socio-Economic Status section. States named are general scope, not addresses.
NAME: affiant's full name; ADDRESS: affiant's street, block, building, city, governorate and postal code.
NAME: author name (repeated); EMAIL: contact information; ADDRESS: city/state given in the author's Affiliation line as his location (elsewhere the town is research scope). URL not a supported type.
ADDRESS: property street address with county, state and ZIP in first sentence. Owner is a company; routing, card, plate and PIN are not supported types.
NAME: First/Last Name and Print Name fields; EMAIL: Email field. Biometric identifier not a supported type.
NAME: taxpayer name; EMAIL: taxpayer email; USERNAME: taxpayer user name. Tax id not a supported type.
EMAIL: travel coordinator email (repeated). No standalone person name outside the email; plate, employee id, routing number not supported types; USA is scope.
IP_ADDRESS: IPv4 and IPv6 server addresses; USERNAME: user account handle; EMAIL: administrative email. MAC address not a supported type.
IP_ADDRESS: private IPv4 in setup and troubleshooting; USERNAME and PASSWORD: login credentials in 2.1; EMAIL: notification email. API key and device id not supported types.
IP_ADDRESS: IPv4 and IPv6 addresses in setup; PASSWORD: password referenced in configuration files step. API key and MAC address not supported types.
